facts.quote: evaluating 900 student conversations against human-scored ground truths
facts.note: the task: scoring Khan Academy 'Explain Your Thinking' conversation items of high-school mathematics interim assessments against trained human raters (dichotomous criteria)

facts.quote: we used Cohen's κ as the primary measure of agreement with human ground truth

facts.note: the cost is an estimate at March 2026 list prices, not a billed amount
